customer_id.meaning: primary id of the customer profile (seed id)

name.meaning: full legal name of the customer as printed on the driver's license

phone_number.meaning: primary phone number on the profile

email.meaning: email address on the profile; empty when the customer has none

date_of_birth.meaning: customer's date of birth as on the driver's license

drivers_license_last4.format: 4 characters, the last four characters of the license number
drivers_license_last4.meaning: last four characters of the customer's driver's license number

zip_code.meaning: ZIP code of the customer's residence address

mailing_address.meaning: street address, city, state and ZIP where notices are mailed, exactly as on file

home_state.meaning: state of residence on the profile

profile_opened_date.meaning: date the customer profile was first created

auto_policy_id.meaning: primary id of one Owner Auto Policy term (each renewal term is its own record)

customer_id.meaning: named insured who owns the term (foreign key -> customers)

variant_name.meaning: liability package carried on the term, written as the official package name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the term (basis: lifecycle.states of the auto charter)

policy_number.meaning: policy number printed on the declarations page; every renewal term keeps the same number

garaging_state.meaning: state where the scheduled vehicles are principally garaged; selects every state schedule

term_months.meaning: length of the term in months

term_number.meaning: 1 for the new-business term, increased by 1 for each renewal term

prior_term_policy_id.meaning: the immediately preceding term of the same policy number (foreign key -> auto_policies); empty for new business

opened_date.meaning: date the new-business term was bound or the renewal term was issued

effective_date.meaning: first day of coverage of the term (coverage starts 12:01 a.m.)

expiration_date.meaning: last boundary of the term: coverage ends 12:01 a.m. on this date

closed_date.meaning: date coverage under the term ended (cancellation effective date, expiration date or not-taken date); empty while open

violation_points.meaning: company violation points of the highest-rated driver at the last rating (36-month MVR lookback)

vehicle_count.meaning: number of vehicles currently scheduled on the term

financial_responsibility_filing.meaning: state certificate the term is written to back, as selected at binding or by endorsement

full_term_premium.meaning: full-term premium rated for the term at binding or on the renewal offer (re-rated by a mid-term limits change)

term_days.meaning: calendar days from effective_date to expiration_date; the denominator of every pro rata computation on the term

cancellation_notice_date.meaning: mailing date of the open notice of cancellation for nonpayment; empty when none

cancellation_effective_date.meaning: date (12:01 a.m.) a noticed or processed cancellation takes or took effect; empty when none

minimum_due_on_notice.meaning: minimum amount due stated on the open notice of cancellation; 0.00 when none

cancellation_reason.meaning: reason of the processed cancellation; empty unless the term is or was cancelled

reinstatement_date.meaning: effective date (12:01 a.m.) of the most recent reinstatement; empty when never reinstated

reinstatement_type.meaning: whether the most recent reinstatement left a gap in coverage; empty when never reinstated

lapse_start_date.meaning: first day without coverage in the most recent lapse (the cancellation effective date or the expiration date for a late renewal); empty when none

lapse_end_date.meaning: last day without coverage in the most recent lapse (the day before coverage resumed); empty when none

term_written_premium.meaning: net written premium of the term: identically the sum of written_premium deltas (premium written plus additional premium minus return premium)

term_fees_charged.meaning: net fully earned fees of the term: identically the sum of policy_fees deltas (fees charged minus fees waived)

auto_premium_txn_id.meaning: primary id of one premium or fee transaction

auto_policy_id.meaning: term the transaction belongs to (foreign key -> auto_policies)

event_type.meaning: event family of the transaction, taken verbatim from the auto charter

effective_date.meaning: coverage date from which the premium change applies (for fees: the date the fee was earned)

amount.meaning: positive amount of the transaction; the family's direction (in/out) gives the sign on its account

transaction_reason.meaning: business reason that produced the transaction

premium_days.meaning: days of the term the premium charge or return covers (0 for fees and for full-term premium written)

source_change_id.meaning: driver or vehicle change the premium arises from (foreign key -> auto_policy_changes); empty otherwise

reversed_txn_id.meaning: for a fee waiver: the fee transaction it reverses (foreign key -> auto_premium_transactions); empty otherwise

auto_change_id.meaning: primary id of one driver or vehicle change on a term

event_type.meaning: event family of the change, taken verbatim from the auto charter

change_effective_date.meaning: date (12:01 a.m.) the change takes effect on the term

driver_name.meaning: full name of the driver concerned, exactly as on the driver's license; empty for vehicle changes

driver_date_of_birth.meaning: date of birth of the driver concerned; empty for vehicle changes

driver_relationship.meaning: relationship of the driver to the named insured; empty for vehicle changes

prior_driver_status.meaning: how the driver stood on the term immediately before this change; empty for vehicle changes

driver_violation_points.meaning: company violation points of the driver at the time of the change

driver_term_premium.meaning: full-term premium share the rating attributes to the driver as a rated driver (0.00 when not rated)

vehicle_vin.meaning: 17-character vehicle identification number of the vehicle concerned; empty for driver changes

vehicle_description.meaning: model year, make and model of the vehicle, e.g. 2014 Nissan Altima; empty for driver changes

vehicle_acquired_date.meaning: date the named insured acquired the vehicle; empty for driver changes and removals

vehicle_term_premium.meaning: full-term premium share the rating attributes to the vehicle (0.00 for driver changes)

signed_form_id.meaning: signed Named Driver Exclusion form backing an exclusion (foreign key -> auto_policy_documents); empty otherwise

auto_document_id.meaning: primary id of one policy notice or signed form

notice_minimum_due.meaning: for a notice of cancellation: the minimum amount due stated on it; 0.00 otherwise

no_loss_attested.meaning: for a Statement of No Loss: true when the insured attests no accident, loss or claim occurred during the lapse period; empty otherwise

requested_effective_date.meaning: for a Named Driver Exclusion form: the effective date requested on the form; empty otherwise

nonrenewal_reason.meaning: for a nonrenewal notice: the reason stated; empty otherwise
